source: Run107 15 valid target windows, 2 cycles, 260 ordered HCCL kernels per rank-cycle
interpretation: HCCL kernel duration may include waiting for peers. Cross-rank timestamp skew is diagnostic only and cannot be subtracted from target wall time without a causal execution model. Ordinal matching assumes same operation order and checks name equality.
decision: The first reduce-scatter accounts for almost all variable communication duration; peer starts span 8.65/20.53ms across cycles while completions converge within <=0.0135ms. Late rank incurs ~0.035ms first-call duration, so shaving early-rank wait does not shorten the collective completion. Remaining 259 HCCL calls have stable 4.8-5.7ms per-rank sum, with no source-backed >=5ms removable transfer. Stable GMM ~10ms is the larger compute-exposure candidate, but needs hardware efficiency and replacement evidence before any edit.
